text:
maria: Heads-up — I'll push svc-search v2.3.1 to canary in 15m. Need smoke volunteers and rollback standby :eyes:
vikram: On it. What canary % are you thinking?
maria: Start at 5% for 10m, then 25% if green. Full rollout after another 15m. Rollback window 20m after full.
sara: I can run the smoke set and tail logs. Ping me when canary is up.
dave: I'll watch infra dashboards (p95/p99, CPU, mem). Setting a short alert for latency + error spikes.
maria: ci-bot — preflight status?
ci-bot: Pre-deploy checks passed: lint ✅, unit tests ✅, canary config validated ✅.
ops-scheduler: Deployment slot reserved for 15:00 PT. On-call notified.
maria: Quick smoke checklist (short): health endpoint, sample search query, tail logs, traces for any 5xx, DB connection errors. Also verify feature flag gating.
maria: ```bash
# smoke script (run against canary)
curl -sS "https://svc-search.canary.redwood/api/health" | jq .
curl -sS "https://svc-search.canary.redwood/api/search?q=smoke-test" | jq '.hits | length'
kubectl logs -n prod deploy/svc-search-canary --tail=200
# small trace query if needed
```
sara: Running the script now, will paste results in a minute.
sara: health: {"status":"ok"}, search hits=3, no 5xx in last 2m of logs.
dave: infra glance: p95 steady, p99 +2ms, CPU up ~4%, no OOMs. No spikes on error budget.
jen: feature flag note: feature_flag=search_v2 enabled for canary group.
maria: If error rate >0.5% or p95 >200ms, we rollback immediately.
sara: Seeing a single 500 trace — null pointer in result formatter. Small fix on PR #891.
maria: Can we hotfix into canary or should we rollback? @vikram?
vikram: Quick look — fix is tiny (null guard). I can branch, patch, and deploy hotfix to canary. Hold full rollout until verified.
jen: Quick CR review done, LGTM.
ci-bot: CI: Hotfix branch built, image pushed as v2.3.1-hotfix1, canary tag updated.
maria: Rolling canary to hotfix build now. Re-running quick smoke.
sara: Smoke after hotfix: health OK, hits=3, logs clean, no new 5xx.
dave: Metrics green. p99 back to baseline. Proceed to 25% in 5m if no regressions.
maria: Moving to 25% now. Will monitor for 15m then consider full.
ops-scheduler: On-call still watching. Noted the 25% bump.
sara: Lowered alert thresholds for error budget during this window, will raise if noisy.
maria: Unless objections, full rollout in ~20m.
vikram: No objections from infra.
sara: Post-deploy items: update release notes, call out hotfix, notify product, close the deploy ticket.
maria: Done — release notes updated and ticket linked. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Deploy finished: svc-search v2.3.1 (hotfix1) -> production. Rollback window closes in 20m.
dave: Final pass — dashboards look healthy, no lingering errors.
maria: Thanks all — great catch on that null. If anything pops, re-open this thread and tag @ops-scheduler and on-call.
